x = 1
def f():
    x = 2
    print('in', x)
f()
print('out', x)

def make_phone_prefix(prefix):
    def norm(raw):
        d = ''.join(c for c in raw if c.isdigit())
        return prefix + d
    return norm
pe = make_phone_prefix('+51')
cl = make_phone_prefix('+56')
print(pe('999'), cl('999'))

def normalize_email(s):
    s = s.strip().lower()
    if '@' not in s:
        raise ValueError('email sin @')
    return s
assert normalize_email('  A@B.COM ') == 'a@b.com'
assert normalize_email(normalize_email('A@B.COM')) == normalize_email('A@B.COM')
print('OK')
